title: The Throne Verse in Sahih International says God does not sleep
summary: Sahih International of Quran 2:255 says neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes God.
body: Sahih International's translation of Quran 2:255, the Throne Verse, says Allah, there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and that neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. The wording on the page includes: "Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
